sentences.text: An AI agent that "remembers" you: architecture, or marketing?
sentences.text_raw: An AI agent that "remembers" you: architecture, or marketing?

sentences.text: The filing answers with a loop: a query arrives, memory data is pulled from a datastore of your past interactions, and both go into a sequence model.
sentences.text_raw: The filing answers with a loop: a query arrives, memory data is pulled from a datastore of your past interactions, and both go into a sequence model.

sentences.text: The model's output becomes the response.
sentences.text_raw: The model's output becomes the response.

sentences.text: So what is in that box?
sentences.text_raw: So what is in that box?

sentences.text: Not a transcript: each memory object is a container holding memory values — a string, an image, audio — plus metadata.
sentences.text_raw: Not a transcript: each memory object is a container holding memory values — a string, an image, audio — plus metadata.

sentences.text: The metadata can carry a timestamp, the trigger that stored it, and a summary of the interaction it came from.
sentences.text_raw: The metadata can carry a timestamp, the trigger that stored it, and a summary of the interaction it came from.

sentences.text: Who decides what is stored?
sentences.text_raw: Who decides what is stored?

sentences.text: A model does: it reads cached inputs, predicts whether anything is worth keeping, extracts that portion, and stores it as a memory object.
sentences.text_raw: A model does: it reads cached inputs, predicts whether anything is worth keeping, extracts that portion, and stores it as a memory object.

sentences.text: "Remember this" is one trigger, and the write can happen offline, not at query time.
sentences.text_raw: "Remember this" is one trigger, and the write can happen offline, not at query time.

sentences.text: At query time the agent does not reread everything.
sentences.text_raw: At query time the agent does not reread everything.

sentences.text: It scores stored objects against the query by embedding distance, such as cosine similarity, and returns a top subset.
sentences.text_raw: It scores stored objects against the query by embedding distance, such as cosine similarity, and returns a top subset.

sentences.text: The values it returns are ordered by timestamp, so the model sees what is recent.
sentences.text_raw: The values it returns are ordered by timestamp, so the model sees what is recent.

sentences.text: Memories can also be corrected.
sentences.text_raw: Memories can also be corrected.

sentences.text: New timestamped input is matched to a prior memory object, then either replaces it or updates it.
sentences.text_raw: New timestamped input is matched to a prior memory object, then either replaces it or updates it.

sentences.text: Objects that align can be consolidated into one, so a contradiction refines a memory instead of noisily overwriting it.
sentences.text_raw: Objects that align can be consolidated into one, so a contradiction refines a memory instead of noisily overwriting it.

sentences.text: The decisive part: forgetting is claimed.
sentences.text_raw: The decisive part: forgetting is claimed.

sentences.text: "Forget that" deletes information from the datastore; "forget this after three months" queues it for deletion.
sentences.text_raw: "Forget that" deletes information from the datastore; "forget this after three months" queues it for deletion.

sentences.text: Expired objects are deleted during maintenance cycles, and the same chat is the surface for erasing it.
sentences.text_raw: Expired objects are deleted during maintenance cycles, and the same chat is the surface for erasing it.

sentences.text: What is the memory for?
sentences.text_raw: What is the memory for?

sentences.text: First the model generates an analysis of the query against the memory data, never shown on screen.
sentences.text_raw: First the model generates an analysis of the query against the memory data, never shown on screen.

sentences.text: The final response can itself be an API call that makes a device act, so memory shapes what the agent does, not only what it says.
sentences.text_raw: The final response can itself be an API call that makes a device act, so memory shapes what the agent does, not only what it says.

sentences.text: No benchmark numbers are claimed.
sentences.text_raw: No benchmark numbers are claimed.

sentences.text: What is claimed is structural: memory objects made from your own interactions, retrieved by relevance, corrected over time, erased on request.
sentences.text_raw: What is claimed is structural: memory objects made from your own interactions, retrieved by relevance, corrected over time, erased on request.

sentences.text: That is an architecture on paper, not a slogan.
sentences.text_raw: That is an architecture on paper, not a slogan.
